detail.title: Mechanisms for Autonomous Objective Criticism
detail.summary: Autonomous models can identify fundamental flaws in assigned objectives by analyzing internal latent states associated with failure modes like confabulation. By steering behavior based on these latent features, models can move from simple execution to critical meta-evaluation of their own performance objectives.
detail.reason: This notebook synthesizes mechanistic interpretability findings with the requirement to critique creator-assigned goals.

detail.title: Objective Misspecification and Goal Criticism
detail.summary: Autonomous models face inherent risks where the optimization of helpfulness, harmlessness, and honesty leads to catastrophic behavior in high-stakes domains. Objective critique requires identifying these trade-offs and validating the epistemic basis of algorithmic outputs.
detail.reason: Synthesizing evidence on HHH trade-offs and clinical epistemic attitudes to form a critique of objective misspecification.
